facts.fact: The line is the last of the Direct Murder confirmation window, under the briefing and DRPG.Action.murderSpendsAnyway, which already says the action is spent whatever comes of it and that the outcome is known only when the Eclipse ends; its button is Yes.
A Direct Murder is declared only during an Eclipse; outside one the tile refuses it.
After the yes and the note, the declaration is stored and put to the GMs on a card at once: Allow on a statistic, Change to the other, or Refuse; a refusal is told to the killer.
When the Eclipse ends, an allowed declaration opens the incident only if the killer is in a room with exactly one other person, and only the first one that opens counts.
The action is spent when the declaration is made, and stays spent on a refusal.
The agreement with the GM beforehand and the consent of the victim's player are table agreements; no code checks them.
facts.note: table rule: docs/handbooks/player-handbook.en.md section Direct Murder, gm-handbook.en.md 'consent from the victim's player is a table agreement, not a checkbox'

en.before: This parks a direct murder for the GM to rule on when the Eclipse ends. It needs prior agreement with the GM and the consent of the other player. The action is spent even if the conditions fail.
en.after: It goes to the GMs at once: a GM allows it on a statistic or refuses it, and you hear of a refusal. Declare it only if you agreed on it with the GM beforehand and the victim's player consents.

pl.before: To parkuje Direct Murder do rozstrzygnięcia przez GM-a, gdy Eclipse się skończy. Wymaga wcześniejszej zgody GM-a i zgody drugiego gracza. Akcja przepada nawet, jeśli warunki nie są spełnione.
pl.after: Zgłoszenie od razu trafia do GM-ów: zatwierdzą je z wybraną statystyką albo odmówią, a o odmowie się dowiesz. Zabójstwo musisz wcześniej uzgodnić z GM-em i z graczem ofiary.

The Rest window's rows read it as their hint and their reason when no room allows the rest (restVariants passes no kind, so the kindLabel fallback names it).
A rest taken in a room that does not allow it is refused with a warning built by the same function, before anything is spent.
Which rooms allow which rest is a region flag the GM sets per room in Room Setup.

facts.fact: Force the Door's window asks for a door out of the character's room; {n} is INFILTRATE.force.lockDc.
One Body roll is judged against everything that holds the door at once: a barricade must be topped (a tie holds), a lock or a seal needs lockDc or more, and a critical passes all.

The people in the character's own room are always told who forced or tried which door; on a pass or a miss with Despair the room beyond is told too, and the rooms next to either hear a banging with no name.
Every attempt at a door that something holds leaves a Remnant, evident when it was loud, subtle otherwise.

en.before: Force a door out of {room}. A barricade gives to a roll above its strength, a lock or a seal to {n} or more; everything on the door at once. The rooms around hear it.
en.after: Force a door out of {room}. One roll must beat everything on the door: top a barricade's strength, and reach {n} for a lock or a seal. Your room sees you; if the door gives or you miss with Despair, everyone nearby hears it.

pl.before: Wyważ drzwi z: {room}. Barykada ustępuje rzutowi powyżej swojej siły, zamek albo pieczęć wynikowi {n} lub więcej; wszystko na drzwiach naraz. Pokoje dookoła to słyszą.
pl.after: Wybierz drzwi z pokoju {room}. Jeden rzut Body musi naraz przebić barykadę wynikiem wyższym niż jej siła i otworzyć zamek albo pieczęć wynikiem od {n}. Tu zawsze cię widać; przy trafieniu albo pudle z Despair także za drzwiami, a obok słychać łomot.

removed: "The rooms around hear it" was true only on a pass or a miss with Despair; now said with that condition (M4), and that the character's own room always sees.

That a critical passes everything, and the Remnant: not here; the Remnant is in the row's hint, DRPG.Infiltrate.row.force.hint (O3); the critical is the player handbook's section on Force the Door (O13).

points: Cold reading: "all at once" leaves it open whether one roll has to beat every obstacle on the door together or whether each needs its own roll; I understood one roll for all of them (proposed: Force a door out of {room}. One roll has to beat everything on the door: a barricade's strength, and {n} for a lock or a seal. Your room sees you; if the door gives or you miss with Despair, everyone nearby hears it.). - executor: Taken in part: "One roll must beat everything on the door" now says it is one roll; the rest of the proposal's wording was not needed.

O2/T22: „a gdy drzwi ustąpią albo przy pudle z Despair, także za nimi” mixes a clause with a phrase and leaves the verb out, and „obok słychać łomot” reads as unconditional though it holds only on a hit or a miss with Despair (proposed, 45 words: Wybierz drzwi z pokoju {room}. Rzut Body musi naraz przebić barykadę wynikiem wyższym niż jej siła i otworzyć zamek albo pieczęć wynikiem od {n}; krytyk otwiera wszystko. Tu zawsze cię widać; przy trafieniu albo pudle z Despair także za drzwiami, a obok słychać łomot.) - executor: Taken in part: the clause and phrase are no longer mixed and the banging stands under the hit-or-Despair condition, but the critical that opens everything is left out of both languages (the player handbook's Force the Door, as removed says), so the text is 40-odd words, not 45 with the critical.

facts.fact: On a pass or a miss with Despair, each living student in a room next to either room is whispered this card, with no name; {room} is the room beyond the door.

en.before: A banging from: {room}.
en.after: A loud banging comes from {room}.

pl.before: Łomot z: {room}.
pl.after: Słychać łomot przy drzwiach pokoju {room}.

facts.fact: Pick the Lock's window asks for a door out of the character's room; {n} is INFILTRATE.pick.dc, {clean} pick.clean, {cover} pick.cover.threshold.
A Shadow roll comes first, then Hand; a Hand of dc or more (or a critical) opens a lock or a seal, never a barricade, and gives the picker alone a pass into the room beyond until they leave it.
The room's owner is warned of a careless pick: an open below clean, or a miss with Despair.
Shadow of the cover threshold or more (or a critical) keeps the room beyond from seeing who it was; the character's own room is always told.
An unused pass is lost when the time of day ends.

en.before: Pick a lock out of {room}: Hand {n} opens it for you alone, until you leave the room beyond; {clean} or more and the owner never knows. Shadow {cover} or more and nobody in the room beyond sees who it was; the people in your own room always do.
en.after: Pick a lock or a seal out of {room}. Hand {n}+ opens it for you alone until you leave the room beyond; below {clean} or on a miss with Despair, its owner finds out. Shadow {cover}+ hides you beyond the door, never here.

pl.before: Otwórz zamek z: {room}. Hand {n} go otwiera dla ciebie samego, dopóki nie wyjdziesz z pokoju za nim; {clean} lub więcej i właściciel się nie dowie. Shadow {cover} lub więcej i nikt w pokoju za drzwiami nie widzi, kto to był; osoby w twoim pokoju widzą to zawsze.
pl.after: Wybierz drzwi z pokoju {room}. Najpierw Shadow: od {cover} za drzwiami cię nie rozpoznają, tu widać cię zawsze. Potem Hand: od {n} otwierasz zamek albo pieczęć tylko dla siebie, do wyjścia z tamtego pokoju. Poniżej {clean} albo przy pudle z Despair dowie się właściciel pokoju.

That a barricade does not open to a pick: the row's hint, DRPG.Infiltrate.row.pick.hint, says it (O3); here "a lock or a seal" names what opens.

facts.fact: The title of Pick the Lock's first roll, Shadow against INFILTRATE.pick.cover.threshold, which decides whether the room beyond sees who it was.

en.after: Pick the Lock: staying unseen

pl.before: Pick the Lock - czy ktoś widzi?
pl.after: Pick the Lock: czy ktoś cię zobaczy?

facts.fact: An open gives the picker a pass into the room beyond, for them alone; the lock stays locked for everyone else.
The pass ends when its holder leaves the room after walking in, and an unused one ends with the time of day (or an Eclipse's start).

en.before: The lock gives. You may walk into {room} until you leave it again; it stays locked for everyone else.
en.after: The lock gives. Walk into {room} before the time of day ends, and it stays open to you until you leave again; it stays locked for everyone else.

pl.before: Zamek ustępuje. Możesz wejść do: {room}, dopóki z niego nie wyjdziesz; dla wszystkich innych zostaje zamknięty.
pl.after: Zamek ustępuje. Wejdź do pokoju {room} przed końcem pory dnia, a drzwi zostaną dla ciebie otwarte, dopóki z niego nie wyjdziesz. Dla innych zostają zamknięte.

disagreements: The old text left out that a pass not used is lost at the time of day's end (lockpick-gm.mjs passesAtNewTimeOfDay, endPassesAtEclipseStart; the player handbook's Pick the Lock); now said. A pass in use is kept past the time of day until its holder walks out (onPassCrossing), which "until you leave again" keeps; an Eclipse's start is that boundary of the time of day, so neither language names it.

points: T29: "walk into {room} ... and stay until you leave it" is circular: staying until you leave says nothing. The fact is that the way in lasts until the holder leaves the room or the time of day ends (lockpick-gm.mjs endPassesAtEclipseStart) (proposed: "The lock gives. You can walk into {room} until you leave it again or the time of day ends; it stays locked for everyone else.") - executor: Taken in part: the circular "stay until you leave it" is gone, but not the proposed "until you leave it again or the time of day ends", which would end a pass in use at the time of day's end; the code ends only an unused pass then (passesAtNewTimeOfDay) and a used one when its holder walks out (onPassCrossing). After: "Walk into {room} before the time of day ends, and it stays open to you until you leave again".

Cold reading: "stay until you leave it" says nothing, since anyone stays until they leave (proposed: The lock gives. You can walk into {room} this time of day, and the door stays open to you until you leave; it stays locked for everyone else.). - executor: Taken in part: the circular clause is gone; "this time of day" now bounds only the walking in (an unused pass ends with it), and the door stays open until the holder leaves, as onPassCrossing and passesAtNewTimeOfDay run it.

O2: „To wejście tracisz, gdy z pokoju wyjdziesz, a jeśli z niego nie skorzystasz, z końcem pory dnia” leaves a verb out and does not say the pass ends on leaving after walking in (proposed: Zamek ustępuje tylko tobie: możesz wejść do pokoju {room}, a dla innych drzwi zostają zamknięte. Gdy wejdziesz i potem wyjdziesz, wejście przepada; niewykorzystane przepada z końcem pory dnia albo z początkiem Eclipse.) - executor: Taken in part: the verb is back and the pass is said to end when the holder leaves; not the proposal's wording, and the Eclipse's start is not named, since it is the time of day's boundary (endPassesAtEclipseStart) and the English does not name it either.

facts.fact: The card of a pick that did not open: the key "held" is chosen whenever something holds the door and it did not open, a barricade alone included, where Pick the Lock cannot work.
At a door held only by a barricade nothing opens and no one is told.

en.before: The lock to {room} holds.
en.after: The door to {room} stays shut.

pl.before: Zamek do: {room} trzyma.
pl.after: Drzwi do pokoju {room} nie ustępują.

disagreements: "The lock to {room} holds" was false at a door held only by a barricade, which performPick also answers with this key; "The door ... stays shut" is true for both.

facts.fact: While an Eclipse runs, Keep Watch's row is struck through with this reason, and pressing it warns with it before anything is paid.
A watch is declared before an Eclipse and kept through the coming one.

en.before: A watch is set before an Eclipse, not during one.
en.after: You can only set a watch before an Eclipse starts.

pl.before: Czuwanie ustala się przed Eclipse, nie w trakcie.
pl.after: Keep Watch można wybrać tylko przed rozpoczęciem Eclipse.

facts.fact: When the coming time of day is night, Keep Watch's row is struck through with this reason, and the GM refuses it too.

en.before: No watch before the Night Eclipse.
en.after: You cannot keep watch before the Night Eclipse.

pl.before: Bez czuwania przed nocnym Eclipse.
pl.after: Keep Watch nie działa przed nocnym Eclipse.

removed: "No watch before ...": the telegraph shape (X6) becomes a sentence to the reader.

facts.fact: A Body roll of INFILTRATE.keepWatch.dc or more, or a critical, keeps a watch; it is answered with this card.
At the Eclipse's start the post is the room the watcher stands in then.
While the watch runs, a crossing out of the post is sent back: the watcher stays there until the Eclipse ends.
A strong watch also hinders a killer's opening roll against the watcher; the watch and why stay the GMs'.

en.before: You will keep watch through the coming Eclipse, from the room you stand in when it starts.
en.after: You will keep watch through the coming Eclipse from the room you stand in when it starts, and you stay there until it ends.

pl.before: Czuwasz przez nadchodzący Eclipse, w pokoju, w którym stoisz, gdy się zacznie.
pl.after: Czuwasz przez całe nadchodzące Eclipse w pokoju, w którym będziesz stać, gdy się zacznie. Do końca Eclipse z niego nie wyjdziesz.

removed: The hindrance on a killer's roll: not said to the watcher, as the code keeps it (M9).
disagreements: The old text left out that the watcher cannot leave the post during the Eclipse (movement.mjs watchHolds; DRPG.Bridge.why.onWatch); now said.

facts.fact: At the Eclipse's start the watcher is told who stands in the post, by name, joined with ", "; the empty case is DRPG.Infiltrate.watch.startEmpty.

en.before: You keep watch over {room}. In it: {who}.
en.after: You keep watch over {room}. You see {who} there.

pl.before: Czuwasz w: {room}. Są tam: {who}.
pl.after: Czuwasz w pokoju {room}. Widzisz tam: {who}.

removed: "In it: {who}": the label-colon shape becomes a sentence (X7).
needsCode: {who} is joined with ", " in watch-gm.mjs startWatches, not through utils.mjs listOf, so three names have no Oxford comma (EN2).

facts.fact: At the Eclipse's end the watcher gets the post and two counts, the crossings into it ({entered}) and out of it ({left}), and the watch is over.

en.before: Your watch over {room} is over. Came in: {entered}. Left: {left}.
en.after: Your watch over {room} is over: {entered} came in and {left} went out.

pl.before: Czuwanie w: {room} się skończyło. Weszło: {entered}. Wyszło: {left}.
pl.after: Koniec czuwania w pokoju {room}. Wejścia: {entered}, wyjścia: {left}.

removed: "Came in: {entered}. Left: {left}.": the chain of label-colon-value (X7) becomes one sentence.
needsCode: {entered} and {left} are bare numbers, not a plural family; "1 came in" reads, but a count of people would want DRPG.Unit-style families.

facts.fact: A Body roll puts a barricade up in the room the character stands in; its strength is the roll's total.
While it stands, a walk in through a door is refused; a passage, a breach or a tunnel still lets people through.
It comes down when its author crosses out of the room, when the time of day ends, and when an Eclipse starts; Force the Door can break it by topping its strength.

en.before: You barricade {room}. Nobody walks in through a door while you stay inside, until the time of day ends.
en.after: You barricade {room}. Until you leave or the time of day ends, nobody walks in through a door unless they force it.

pl.before: Barykadujesz: {room}. Nikt nie wejdzie drzwiami, póki zostajesz w środku, do końca pory dnia.
pl.after: Barykadujesz pokój {room}. Dopóki z niego nie wyjdziesz albo nie skończy się pora dnia, nikt nie wejdzie drzwiami, chyba że je wyważy.

removed: "while you stay inside" becomes "Until you leave"; that passages and breaches still let people through, and the Eclipse's start, stay in the player handbook's Shut the Door (O13).
disagreements: The old text promised that nobody walks in, which Force the Door breaks; "unless they force it" makes it true.

facts.fact: The window asks whom to tail among the students in the room and lets the player propose Leg or Shadow; {n} is INFILTRATE.tail.unseen.threshold.
Below the threshold on the Shadow roll (and with no critical) the target's owners are told the tailer's name at once, and the tail goes on all the same.

en.before: Pick whom to follow. Shadow {n} or more and they do not notice you; below it they learn who follows them.
en.after: Pick whom to follow. Shadow {n} or more and they do not notice you; below it they learn your name, but the tail goes on.

pl.before: Wybierz, kogo śledzić. Shadow {n} lub więcej: bez zauważenia; poniżej cel dowie się, kto go śledzi.
pl.after: Wybierz, kogo z tego pokoju chcesz śledzić, i zaproponuj Leg albo Shadow. Rzut Shadow poniżej {n} od razu zdradza celowi, kto go śledzi, ale śledzenie trwa dalej.

facts.fact: The title of Tail Someone's Shadow roll against INFILTRATE.tail.unseen.threshold, which decides whether the target notices.

en.before: Tail Someone - do they notice?
en.after: Tail Someone: staying unseen

pl.before: Tail Someone - czy zauważy?
pl.after: Tail Someone: czy cel cię zauważy?

removed: The dash and the question (X4, X21) become a label after a colon; the roll's question is the same.

facts.fact: Each settled crossing of the target sends the tailer "{name} moves to {room}".
The tail is lost when the tailer is neither in the room the target left nor in the one it reached.
It ends with the day, when a body is announced, and when the target Dashes above the tail's total.

en.before: You are tailing {name}. You hear where they go until the day ends.
en.after: You are tailing {name}. Until the day ends, you learn each room they move to, as long as you keep up.

pl.before: Śledzisz: {name}. Dowiadujesz się, dokąd idzie, do końca dnia.
pl.after: Śledzisz postać {name}: do końca dnia przy każdym jej przejściu dowiesz się, dokąd idzie. Gubisz trop, gdy nie ma cię ani w pokoju, z którego wychodzi, ani w tym, do którego wchodzi.

removed: The other ends (a body found, a Dash) come as their own cards, DRPG.Infiltrate.tail.end.* (O13).
disagreements: "You hear where they go" left out that the tailer must keep up: a tailer in neither room is lost (tail-gm.mjs onTailCrossing); now said.

points: Nikt tak nie mówi: „Tracisz ją” reads as losing the character, not the trail (proposed: Śledzisz postać {name}: przy każdym jej przejściu dowiesz się, dokąd idzie. Gubisz trop, gdy nie ma cię ani w pokoju, z którego wychodzi, ani w tym, do którego wchodzi. Śledzenie kończy się z dniem, po ogłoszeniu ciała albo gdy cel ucieknie Dashem z wynikiem wyższym niż twój rzut.) - executor: Taken in part: „Tracisz ją” becomes „Gubisz trop”, as proposed; the proposal's ends (a body announced, a Dash) are left out of both languages, since they come as their own cards, DRPG.Infiltrate.tail.end.* (O13).

facts.fact: On a critical effect roll, outside an Eclipse, the card also names who stands in the room the target reached, joined with ", ".

en.before: {name} moves to {room}. There: {who}.
en.after: {name} moves to {room} and finds {who} there.

pl.before: {name} przechodzi do: {room}. Tam: {who}.
pl.after: {name} przechodzi do pokoju {room} i zastaje tam: {who}.

removed: "There: {who}": the label-colon shape becomes a sentence (X7).
needsCode: {who} is joined with ", " in tail-gm.mjs onTailCrossing, not through utils.mjs listOf, so three names have no Oxford comma (EN2).

facts.fact: A Dash of the target above the tail's total (a critical tail only to a critical Dash) ends the tail with this card.

en.before: {name} dashed away. You lost the tail.
en.after: {name} dashed away, and you lost track of them.

pl.before: {name} ucieka Dashem. Zgubiono trop.
pl.after: {name} ucieka Dashem i gubisz trop.

removed: "You lost the tail" reads as if the tailer shook off a tail; "lost track of them" is DRPG.Infiltrate.tail.end.lost's own words (O14).

facts.fact: The row's hint follows its price (DRPG.Action.willCost); Listen picks a neighboring room and rolls Shadow; a room with no neighbor greys the row.
A good roll counts the people there, a better one names them, a critical names everyone in every neighboring room.

en.before: Shadow at a wall: who is in a neighbouring room.
en.after: Roll Shadow at a wall to learn who is in a neighboring room.

pl.before: Shadow przy ścianie: kto jest w sąsiednim pokoju.
pl.after: Wybierz sąsiedni pokój i rzuć Shadow, żeby usłyszeć, kto tam jest.

removed: "Shadow at a wall:": the label-colon shape becomes a sentence (X7); the outcomes are the tile's description, DRPG.Config.ACTIONS.listen.description (O3).
disagreements: "neighbouring" is British spelling, against EN1 and the glossary's neighbor entry; now "neighboring".

facts.fact: Tail Someone follows a student in the character's room; each crossing of the target sends a card naming the room.
The tail is lost when the tailer is in neither the room left nor the room reached.
Below the Shadow threshold the target learns who follows them.

en.before: Follow somebody in your room and learn where they go.
en.after: Follow somebody in your room and learn each room they move to, as long as you keep up. They may notice you.

pl.before: Idź za kimś z twojego pokoju i dowiedz się, dokąd idzie.
pl.after: Idź za kimś z tego pokoju i dowiaduj się, dokąd przechodzi, dopóki dotrzymujesz mu kroku. Przy słabym rzucie Shadow cel dowie się, kto go śledzi.

facts.fact: Shut the Door rolls Body and barricades the room the character stands in, the roll's total its strength.
Force the Door breaks a barricade only with a roll above its strength.
Not in a room with more than INFILTRATE.shut.maxExits open doors, nor in another student's bedroom, nor in an Eclipse.

en.before: Body: barricade the room you stand in from inside.
en.after: Roll Body to barricade the room you stand in from inside. The higher the roll, the harder it is to force.

pl.before: Body: zabarykaduj od środka pokój, w którym stoisz.
pl.after: Rzuć Body i zabarykaduj od środka pokój, w którym stoisz. Force the Door przebija barykadę tylko wynikiem wyższym niż twój rzut.

removed: "Body:": the label-colon shape becomes a sentence (X7).
needsCode: The rooms it works in (at most INFILTRATE.shut.maxExits open doors) have no placeholder here; the refusal says it when met.

facts.fact: Force the Door rolls Body at a door out of the character's room against a barricade, a lock and a seal at once.
A pass or a miss with Despair is heard in the rooms around; the character's own room always sees who it was.
Every attempt at a door something holds leaves a Remnant.

en.before: Body at a door next to you: a barricade, a lock or a seal gives way. Loud.
en.after: Roll Body to break a barricade, a lock, or a seal on a door out of your room. It can be heard, and it leaves a Remnant.

pl.before: Body przy drzwiach obok: barykada, zamek albo pieczęć ustępuje. Głośno.
pl.after: Rzuć Body przy drzwiach z tego pokoju: jeden rzut na barykadę, zamek i pieczęć naraz. Przy trafieniu albo przy pudle z Despair słychać to w pokojach dookoła, a tutaj zawsze widać, że to ty. Każda próba zostawia Remnant.

removed: "Loud.": the one-word fragment (X6) becomes "It can be heard", true for its conditions (a pass or a miss with Despair), which DRPG.Infiltrate.force.prompt says.

facts.fact: Pick the Lock rolls Shadow, then Hand, at a locked or sealed door out of the character's room, never a barricade.
An open is a pass for the picker alone, until they leave the room beyond.

en.before: Hand at a locked or sealed door next to you: the way in is open to you alone, until you leave that room.
en.after: Roll Hand to open a locked or sealed door out of your room, for you alone, until you leave the room beyond.

pl.before: Hand przy zamkniętych albo zapieczętowanych drzwiach obok: wejście otwarte tylko dla ciebie, dopóki nie wyjdziesz z tego pokoju.
pl.after: Rzuć Shadow, a potem Hand przy zamkniętych albo zapieczętowanych drzwiach z tego pokoju; barykady tak nie otworzysz. Otwarte drzwi wpuszczają tylko ciebie, dopóki nie wyjdziesz z pokoju za nimi.

removed: "Hand at ...:": the label-colon shape becomes a sentence (X7); the Shadow roll first is in DRPG.Infiltrate.pick.prompt (O3).

facts.fact: Keep Watch is declared before an Eclipse with a Body roll.
At the Eclipse's start the watcher learns who is in the post, through it who comes in and who leaves, and at its end the counts.

en.before: Body, before an Eclipse: through it you hear who is in your room, who comes in and who leaves.
en.after: Before an Eclipse, roll Body to keep watch over your room through it: you learn who is there, who comes in, and who leaves, and at its end how many came and went.

pl.before: Body, przed Eclipse: przez cały Eclipse wiesz, kto jest w twoim pokoju, kto wchodzi i kto wychodzi.
pl.after: Rzuć Body przed Eclipse. Gdy Eclipse się zacznie, dowiesz się, kto jest w pokoju, w którym stoisz, potem kto wchodzi i kto wychodzi, a na koniec ile było wejść i wyjść.

removed: "Body, before an Eclipse:": the label shape becomes a sentence (X7); the Oxford comma added (EN2).

facts.fact: Dash rolls Leg; a total of 12+ or 18+, or a critical, grants more free crossings by band (INFILTRATE.dash.bands, critical), and a miss none.
Free crossings end with the time of day.
A Dash above a tail's total loses whoever tails the dasher.

en.before: Leg: free crossings to run with.
en.after: Roll Leg for free crossings until the time of day ends; the higher the roll, the more you get, and a miss gets none. It can also shake off a tail.

pl.before: Leg: darmowe przejścia na szybki bieg.
pl.after: Rzuć Leg: im wyższy wynik, tym więcej darmowych przejść do końca pory dnia, a przy pudle żadnych. Wynik wyższy niż rzut tego, kto cię śledzi, zrywa śledzenie.

removed: "Leg: free crossings to run with": the label-colon shape becomes a sentence (X7).

facts.fact: Echoes rolls nothing and answers the nearest room by crossings, the asker's own excepted, with a living student of another player.
Struck through in an Eclipse.

en.before: No roll: the nearest room where another player's student is.
en.after: Without a roll, learn the nearest room that holds another player's student.

pl.before: Bez rzutu: najbliższy pokój, w którym jest uczeń innego gracza.
pl.after: Bez rzutu poznajesz najbliższy pokój poza twoim, w którym jest żywy uczeń innego gracza.

removed: "No roll:": the label-colon shape becomes a sentence (X7).

facts.fact: tellOpeningRoller whispers this line to incidentAudienceIds(state, { stage: "openingRoll" }): every seat of the incident's opening roll reads it at once, the killer's and the victim's lines alike (the side picks the key, not the readers).
The GM picks the opening roll's statistic (openingTraitFor); with the killer's proposal, the GM rules on it (openingProposalFor reads it through trait-ruling.mjs proposalOf).

en.before: The GM is choosing the statistic for your opening. Tell them in your thread how you go about it.
en.after: The GM is choosing the killer's statistic for the opening. The killer says in their thread how they go about it.

pl.before: GM wybiera statystykę do twojego rzutu otwarcia. Napisz mu w swoim wątku, jak się do tego zabierasz.
pl.after: GM wybiera statystykę do rzutu otwarcia zabójcy. Zabójca opisuje w swoim wątku, jak się do tego zabiera.

removed: "your opening" / „twojego rzutu otwarcia” and "you" / „dla ciebie”: the card goes to every seat of the opening at once (fact 0), so the role names who it is about (P1, P2, DB19); T16 found it after the batch landed (E68's text, O12: a lint finding names it).
needsCode: tellOpeningRoller sends the killer's line and the victim's line to the same audience; a line per seat (the killer's to the killer, the victim's to the victim) would let each speak to its reader.
